Influenza.fatigue: Fatigue is commonly associated with Influenza.
Influenza.body_pain: Body pain matches historical patterns for this disease.
Influenza.chills: Chills are a common early symptom.

Common Cold.runny_nose: A runny nose is a primary symptom of a common cold.
Common Cold.sneezing: Sneezing frequently occurs with upper respiratory infections.
Common Cold.cough: Mild cough often accompanies a cold.
Common Cold.sore_throat: Sore throat is a typical early sign of a cold.
Common Cold.mild_fever: Mild fever can sometimes present with a cold.

COVID-19.loss_of_smell: Loss of smell is a highly specific indicator for COVID-19.
COVID-19.fever: Fever is a very common symptom.
COVID-19.cough: Dry cough is a frequent symptom.

Viral Fever.fever: High body temperature is the primary indicator.
Viral Fever.headache: Headaches are common during viral episodes.
Viral Fever.body_pain: Generalized body aches are a standard symptom.
Viral Fever.chills: Chills often precede the onset of fever.

Gastroenteritis.vomiting: Vomiting is a strong indicator of stomach infection.
Gastroenteritis.diarrhoea: Diarrhoea points directly to gastrointestinal distress.
Gastroenteritis.stomach_pain: Stomach pain is central to this condition.
Gastroenteritis.loss_of_appetite: Loss of appetite is typical with stomach illness.

Migraine.headache: Severe, throbbing headache is the defining symptom.
Migraine.nausea: Nausea is a common secondary symptom.
Migraine.vomiting: Vomiting can occur during severe episodes.
Migraine.dizziness: Dizziness or vertigo can sometimes be present.

Malaria.chills: Severe chills (rigors) are a hallmark of Malaria.
Malaria.fever: Cyclical fever is typical for this infection.
Malaria.sweating: Profuse sweating often follows the fever stage.
Malaria.headache: Headaches are common during the fever phase.
Malaria.fatigue: General weakness follows the cyclical attacks.

Dengue Fever.joint_pain: Severe joint and muscle pain ('breakbone fever') is highly characteristic.
Dengue Fever.fever: Sudden onset of high fever is typical.
Dengue Fever.skin_rash: A characteristic skin rash often appears.
Dengue Fever.redness_of_eyes: Eye pain and redness are frequently reported.
Dengue Fever.headache: Severe headaches are a primary symptom.

Typhoid.high_fever: Sustained high fever is the primary feature.
Typhoid.constipation: Constipation is common in early stages.
Typhoid.loss_of_appetite: Loss of appetite is a general systemic response.

Pneumonia.breathlessness: Difficulty breathing indicates lower respiratory infection.
Pneumonia.chest_pain: Chest pain, especially when breathing deeply, is characteristic.
Pneumonia.cough: Coughing, often producing phlegm, is central.
Pneumonia.phlegm: Production of phlegm supports a lung infection diagnosis.

Allergy.sneezing: Sneezing is a primary allergic response.
Allergy.itching: Itching points strongly to an allergic reaction.
Allergy.runny_nose: Runny nose (allergic rhinitis) is very common.
Allergy.skin_rash: Skin rashes or hives indicate systemic allergy.
Allergy.redness_of_eyes: Red, itchy eyes are a typical symptom.

Diabetes.polyuria: Frequent urination (polyuria) is a classic sign of high blood sugar.
Diabetes.excessive_hunger: Excessive hunger (polyphagia) is a hallmark symptom.
Diabetes.weight_loss: Unexplained weight loss can occur despite increased hunger.
Diabetes.fatigue: Fatigue results from poor cellular glucose uptake.
Diabetes.blurred_and_distorted_vision: Blurred vision can occur due to fluid shifts in the eye.

Hypertension.headache: Severe headaches can occur with high blood pressure.
Hypertension.chest_pain: Chest pain may indicate strain on the heart.
Hypertension.fast_heart_rate: Palpitations can accompany high blood pressure.
Hypertension.breathlessness: Shortness of breath may occur in severe cases.

Anemia.fatigue: Fatigue is the most common symptom due to low oxygen transport.
Anemia.weakness_in_limbs: General weakness points to reduced oxygenation.
Anemia.dizziness: Dizziness can result from reduced oxygen to the brain.
Anemia.breathlessness: Shortness of breath, especially on exertion, is typical.

Urinary Tract Infection.burning_micturition: Burning during urination is a strong indicator of a UTI.
Urinary Tract Infection.bladder_discomfort: Discomfort or pain in the lower abdomen is common.
Urinary Tract Infection.continuous_feel_of_urine: A persistent urge to urinate is a hallmark symptom.
Urinary Tract Infection.fever: Fever indicates the infection may be spreading.
